text:
以下为该 PEC 会议页面中**可见**文字、表格信息（含决定/行动项相关表述）提取，已用简洁中文整理：

## 页面标题/基本信息
- **BI 765845 (STEMI) Report [TA Priority]**
- 公司标识：Boehringer Ingelheim
- 右上：Date（Current Month），切换项：Project / Risk / **Study**
- 页脚：**ONLY FOR INTERNAL USE**；页码：**42**；“Presentation title”（未填写）

## 左侧项目信息（可见字段）
- **Name of Project**：BI 765845 (STEMI)
- **Mode of Action**：MYDGF replacement therapy
- **Molecule Type**：Biological
- **Indication**：myocardial infarction
- **Stage**：→ PoCP
- **Application form (route of administration)**：i.v. infusion
- 底部小表（部分可见）：
  - Indication：Myocardial Infarction
  - **NDA Sub**：2030/7/1
  - **NDA appr(base)**：2032/1/1

## 右侧状态
- **Global Status**：gPh IIa ongoing
- **China Status**：participation in gPh III under evaluation

---

## 表格1：Key Updates（关键更新）
| Topic | Detail |
|---|---|
| asset timeline | PoCP timeline shifted from Jun to Oct 2025, and NDA timeline shifted for 4 months accordingly |
| China Integration | to closely monitor the potential implementation of regulatory data exclusivity in China, which will provide market exclusivity and enable China integration |

> 行动/决定相关可见表述：**“to closely monitor …”**（密切监测中国监管数据独占实施的可能性，以支持中国整合）

---

## 表格2：Issue/risk（问题/风险）
| Topic | Description | Probability of occurrence | Impact description | Impact level | Mitigation Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patent issue | Due to lack of patent and data exclusivity for bioproduct in China, China may not be able to join the global development of this asset. | Medium | This product may not be approved or launched in China. | Medium | To closely monitor the evolution of patent related laws/regulation in China to seek opportunity |

> 行动项（缓解计划）可见内容：**密切监测中国专利相关法律/法规演变以寻找机会**  
> 决定：本页未出现明确“决定/结论”字样（仅有时间线变更与监测/缓解计划描述）。
